comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
7-item Memorial Album (to be added with Seven Wonders 1.25 update) related to modifying base items with transmutation alchemy and Sophia points. It consists of the following items:

Sextant transmutes to -> Sextant of Wisdom
Silver Ring transmutes to -> Mathematician's Ring
Aztec Calendar transmutes to -> Calendar Watch of Wisdom
Noble Wooden Paneling transmutes to -> Special Black-purple Wooden Paneling
Noble Metal Paneling transmutes to -> Special Black-purple Metal Paneling
Gold Brooch transmutes to -> Chandelier
Oak Plating transmutes to -> Simple Sailors' Calculating Tool

The reward is: The Companion to Mathematics
Obtained from Michelangelo (Venice)

Further details on the respective items' pages. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Skill/Product/Alchemy/Sophia
wittyship.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1233.html

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Note: unlike the previous updates, it appears the above MA items will require making actual Legacy discoveries in order to unlock their recipes for transmutation. The quest to unlock the appropriate Legacy theme is Legacy TH3. Precise Artillery Calculator -- it will then become selectable under the Book of Wisdom's Legacy theme section.

Using your Book of Wisdom's clock-like discovery section for Legacies, here is which discovery unlocks which recipe (with the location in parentheses):

Top / 12:00 -> Noble Metal Paneling recipe (Lima North)
Upper Right / 2:00 -> Gold brooch (Northwest Genoa)
Lower Right / 4:00 -> Sextant (Eastern Mt. Emei)
Bottom / 6:00 -> Silver ring (Edo)
Lower Left / 8:00 -> Aztec calendar (Edinburgh)
Upper Left / 10:00 -> Oak Plating (Frankfurt)
Center -> Noble Wooden Paneling (West Athens)

This 'discovery->recipe unlocked' condition seems to apply only to mini-update Legacy additions and not main chapter Legacy updates like the future Chapter 2: Rhodes and Ephesos. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Quest%2FAdventure%2FLegacy (Calculator sub-section)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Extra note: for those who wish to complete this MA (or indeed just find all the Legacy discoveries for fun), be advised that the lower right / 4:00 position discovery has a hidden requirement before it can be found.

I am told by players wiser than me that you must have discovered Leshan Giant Buddha from the [DBLNK:99997220] quest; if you do not have it in your discovery list then its slot will be darkened/blacked out when you're combining clues and it can NEVER be obtained until you complete that discovery quest.

Most likely this applies to any Legacy themes involving an inland discovery; however, the Calculators Legacy theme is unique as every discovery unlocks a special recipe for transmutation alchemy. I wonder if port permits are also a hidden requirement...?

Well, you are thus warned. Cheers!
